title: The Kite in the Tree
text: {{name}} played with a red kite in the park. The wind was strong today. The kite went up and up. But the kite stayed in a tall tree. {{name}} could not get it. {{name}} looked up at the tree. {{name}} felt very sad. Then a big dinosaur came. It came to {{name}}. It was very tall and kind. "Hello! I am Spike," it said. "I can help you," Spike said. Spike put its head up high. The kite was very high too. Spike got the kite gently. Then Spike gave it back. "Thank you, Spike!" {{name}} said. {{name}} was so happy again. They played with the kite together. The kite flew in the blue sky. {{name}} and Spike ran and laughed. What a fun afternoon!

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} fly in the park?

options: The kite stayed in a tree
